definition: Creates, fabricates, assembles, grows, extracts, or otherwise produces a physical or digital product supplied into a market.
Transforms raw, intermediate, or recovered inputs into a processed, refined, formulated, or otherwise marketable output.
Performs an intangible, professional, technical, operational, institutional, or community service for another party or beneficiary.
Operates an ongoing facility, system, business process, network, venue, fleet, program, or other productive activity as a continuing market function.
Sells goods or services primarily to end users or consumers through physical, digital, direct, or omnichannel channels.
Aggregates, warehouses, markets, or distributes goods or supplies between producers and downstream commercial, institutional, or retail buyers.
Moves people, freight, commodities, energy, information, or other transferable value through a managed transportation or transmission service.
Operates a digital or physical platform that enables discovery, interaction, exchange, transactions, distribution, or participation among multiple market sides.
Operates infrastructure or a network whose availability, capacity, or connectivity enables other market participants to function.
Assumes, prices, pools, transfers, or administers specified financial or insurable risks in exchange for premium, consideration, or contractual terms.
Provides credit, financing, lending capacity, or credit-bearing facilities to individuals, organizations, transactions, or assets.
Facilitates payments, securities, deposits, capital formation, custody, brokerage, clearing, or other financial transactions between market participants.
Manages investment portfolios, pooled assets, fiduciary capital, or other financial assets under a defined mandate for owners or beneficiaries.
Owns or controls a productive, financial, real, intellectual, or infrastructure asset whose use, lease, development, or deployment participates in the market.
Creates, develops, constructs, improves, or brings a site, facility, product, project, or asset from concept toward operational or market-ready condition.
Creates, curates, publishes, broadcasts, streams, or distributes informational, entertainment, advertising, or other media content as a market activity.
Authorizes another party to use intellectual property, a brand, a business system, a controlled right, or other licensed market asset under defined terms.
Creates, sponsors, funds, purchases, commissions, or issues a market need, request, acquisition, investment, program, or other demand-side opportunity.
